en: A vintage postcard showing a mid-century modern hotel building with multiple balconies, labeled 'Рубин' (Rubin) on the roof. In the foreground, there's a grassy area and a sign with 'GORSKI KAT' and an illustration of a bear eating at a table. Several classic cars are parked outside. The back of the card includes multilingual text identifying the hotel, including Bulgarian, French, and German, and an official stamp with numbers and date.
